units.source_text: 到了五月，梅雨连绵，天色阴晦，紫夫人的病犹未痊愈，只是比以前略微好些，但也时时发作。

en.t: By May, the plum rains went on and on, the skies were dark and gloomy, and Lady Murasaki's illness still had not healed; she was only a little better than before, and the attacks still came from time to time.

units.source_text: 源氏为欲替六条妃子的鬼魂赎罪，每日虔诵法华经一部，以资供养。

en.t: Genji, wishing to atone for the sins of Lady Rokujo's ghost, devoutly recited one full copy of the Lotus Sutra every day as an offering for her.

units.source_text: 此外又做种种尊严的法事。

en.t: In addition, he had many solemn Buddhist rites performed.

units.source_text: 连紫夫人枕头近旁，也有特选的声音庄重的法师，昼夜不断地诵经。

en.t: Even beside Lady Murasaki's pillow, specially chosen monks with grave and dignified voices recited sutras without cease, day and night.

units.source_text: 那鬼魂自从一度显灵之后，又屡次出现，向人诉苦，却总不肯离去。

en.t: After that ghost had once revealed itself, it appeared again and again, complaining of its suffering to people, yet it stubbornly refused to leave.

units.source_text: 天气渐渐炎热，紫夫人又有几次昏死过去，身体更加衰弱了。

en.t: As the weather gradually grew hotter, Lady Murasaki fainted as if dead several more times, and her body became still weaker.

units.source_text: 源氏的忧愁，笔墨难于形容。

en.t: Genji's grief was beyond the power of brush and ink to describe.

units.source_text: 紫夫人在濒危之时，也很关怀源氏的痛苦。

en.t: Even as she hovered near death, Lady Murasaki was deeply concerned for Genji's anguish.

units.source_text: 她想：“我身即使去世，亦已毫无遗憾。

en.t: She thought, "Even if I myself were to pass away, I would have no regrets at all.

units.source_text: 只是我夫为我如此苦痛，我倘抛开不管，实在对他不起。”

en.t: But if my husband suffers so terribly because of me, and I simply abandon him, I would truly be failing him."

units.source_text: 于是努力振作，并且吃些汤药。

en.t: So she made an effort to rally herself, and also took some medicinal broth.

units.source_text: 想是因此之故，六月里病势渐渐好转，有时竟能起坐了。

en.t: Perhaps because of this, in June her condition gradually improved, and at times she was even able to sit up.

units.source_text: 源氏喜不自胜，然而还是担心，防她以后复发，故六条院几乎全然不去。

en.t: Genji was beside himself with joy, yet he remained anxious, fearing that she might relapse later, and so he almost never went to the Rokujo estate at all.
